label_provenance: Agent-authored semantic scope, coverage, abstention and minimal selection obligations; not human-reviewed, external holdout or network-ground-truth labels. Frozen before runtime edits.
split_policy: Distinct scenario_group and paraphrase_group IDs; no paraphrase family appears across splits. Both are generated semantic tests; repeated capability IDs are intentional.
model_boundary: Expected labels and case metadata must never enter inference prompts. Scripted mode is a lexical test double, not model-quality evidence.
selection_policy: Canonical minimal skill/function sets, including identity dependency and reviewed optional route; redundant broad selections lose precision. Coverage scored independently.
answer_coverage_policy: Required semantic ports must be selected into answer via verified evidence_ids. This is structured evidence coverage, not a human judgement of prose quality.
calls_policy: Expected bounds count bounded attempts including failed calls; reported separately from selection/coverage.
rca_policy: Observation predicates may be TRUE; no scenario establishes causal root cause or repair.
provider_policy: Deterministic synthetic laptop-provider replay through real live-profile Core/Verifier/RCA; runtime linux_live flag is not proof of OS measurement. No OS/router access by default.
